description:
This process begins when a potential customer inquires about a product or service.
Sales staff or customer support collects relevant information and addresses any concerns or questions.
If the customer is interested, they are guided through selecting the appropriate product or service.
Next, the sales representative provides a quote, and after approval from the customer, the process moves to order placement.
The order is then recorded in the system, and the customer receives confirmation of their order.
The process ends when the order is successfully placed and confirmed.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_SalesOrder" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/sales-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Quote" name="Quote"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Approval" name="Quote approval"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SalesOrder" name="Sales order process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_SalesOrder">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesSupport" name="Sales staff or customer support">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Inquiry</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddressConcerns</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Interest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotInterested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GuideSelection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideQuote</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_QuoteApproval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderConfirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Inquiry" name="Customer inquires about a product or service">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddressConcerns" name="Address concerns and questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interest" name="Is the customer interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Interested</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotInterested" name="Customer is not interested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide product or service selection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Interested</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote" messageRef="Message_Quote">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_QuoteApproval" name="Customer approves quote">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Approval" messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in the system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderConfirmed" name="Order successfully placed and confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns" targetRef="Gateway_Interest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Interested" sourceRef="Gateway_Interest" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerIsInterested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="Not interested" sourceRef="Gateway_Interest" targetRef="End_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Event_QuoteApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Event_QuoteApproval" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SalesOrder">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Sales" name="Sales process" processRef="Process_SalesOrder"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quote" name="Quote" messageRef="Message_Quote" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval" name="Quote approval" messageRef="Message_Approval" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_QuoteApproval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
